title: Bosun Fleet JSON-RPC 2.0 Method Matrix v1
description: Canonical catalog of the 56 fleet JSON-RPC 2.0 methods (Realms 02 through 25) routed by harbormaster over stdio NDJSON (no sockets). Named params only (arrays are rejected). `$defs` holds JSON-RPC envelopes, per-method params/result schemas, and the catalog entry shape. The `methods` object is the reviewable catalog (same hybrid pattern as event-vocab-v0.1.json). Broadcast names are spec-level `info.<vessel>.*` events; harbormaster stub handlers do not emit them yet. Read methods list an empty broadcasts array.

jsonrpcId.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request id. Fleet methods are request/response, not notifications; id is required and must be a string or number.

path.description: Optional vault-relative scan path. Defaults to '.'.

public_key.description: Public key text or OpenSSH format
